notes: Rabi'a asks Aisha about the fasting and she answers, so she is the last link (rule 5). The text names Rabi'a ibn al-Ghaz; the sources disagree on this level.

fixes.reason: HKG names the third link at this position as Rabi'a ibn Amr ibn al-Harith, which the text does not write; the text names Rabi'a ibn al-Ghaz.
